title: Electric light control experiment (15 subjects, 4 classes, 31 EEG ch)
description: A P300-based brain-computer interface dataset for home appliance control, comprising EEG recordings from 15 healthy subjects performing a visual oddball task with 31-channel recordings at 500 Hz sampling rate. The dataset includes 50 training and 30 testing trials per subject, with target and non-target stimulus classifications for evaluating BCI performance in an online feedback paradigm.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 31-channel actiCHamp system (Brain Products) at 500 Hz sampling rate with linked mastoid reference and active sensors. Participants performed a P300 oddball task with visual flash stimuli presented on an LCD display at 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. The experimental protocol included online visual feedback and was conducted in a laboratory setting with 15 healthy subjects (mean age 22.13±2.2 years).
